reexport_instructions.why_it_failed: TradingView's 'Export chart data' writes ONLY the bars currently loaded in the chart (~20k bar cap ≈ 3 weeks of 1m). The chart must be scrolled/paged back until June 1 bars are visible/loaded BEFORE exporting.
reexport_instructions.option_a_precise: On the 1m PEPPERSTONE:XAUUSD chart, keep dragging the chart left (or press Home/use 'Go to date' 2026-06-01) until bars from Jun-01 are on screen; wait for history to load; then Export chart data. Verify the FIRST row's epoch is <= 1780358400 (2026-06-02 00:00Z) before uploading. Repeat if the 20k cap trims the tail — two overlapping exports (loaded-to-Jun-01 and loaded-to-Jun-11) are fine; the importer dedups by timestamp.
reexport_instructions.option_b_fallback_5m: If 1m history that far back will not load, switch the SAME chart to 5m, use 'Go to date' 2026-06-01, and export once — ~6,000 bars covers ALL of June. Matching then runs at 5m precision (entry/SL/TP touch detection still valid; claim-timing snapshots coarser). Name it XAUUSD_5M_2026-06-01_to_2026-06-30.csv.
